model: The public i-2, i-1, i InLegalBERT checkpoint, keeping the other two release donors unchanged
edit: Modify chosen columns of bert.encoder.layer.11.output.dense.weight and its output bias. Map class-centered training residuals to pre-LayerNorm hidden displacements with an analytic local linearization. Select 24 feed-forward neurons per seven role contrasts and three high-priority role pairs, using training labels only.
cohorts: 192 public train judgments to write tensors, 48 validation for selector, 72 and 96 separate retrospective validation cohorts
selector: Maximum mean of all seven-role F1 and lexical-unmatched seven-role F1, with no more pair swaps than incumbent on either selector slice. Zero edit allowed.
controls: Native unmodified, norm-matched shuffled writes, per-encoder standalone, replay versus physically installed checkpoint. When zero wins, also physically test the predeclared 0.85-strength context-residual on every validation cohort.
promotion: Require a real frozen patch to improve seven-role F1 and reduce total None/Reasoning swaps in each of the 72 and 96 validation cohorts. Then open an official comparison. Only the T4 is used for forward passes.
